decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's secure enterprise messaging platform that remained prominently marketed through 2024, it is likely to be retained as part of the integrated cloud communications portfolio.

This product fits directly with the firm's core offer of multi-channel business communication and, as a newly launched gateway service, is likely to be given more time to build adoption rather than being withdrawn quickly.
Because it complements the firm's email, messaging and automation services and broadens channel integration for enterprise workflows, management would likely keep it on the market in 2025.
